title_zh: 约定限定发明展签的首创说法

scenario.label_zh: 约定限定发明展签的首创说法
scenario.goal_zh: 区分专利记录与发明起源的证据，并约定保留有依据的先驱描述而不宣称最早首创

context_zh: 博物馆教育项目的两位成人学员讨论虚构工程师的档案展签。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Did this water-saving valve originate with Ellis? Our label calls her the first person ever to make one.

sentences.speaker: Isaac
sentences.text: The archive shows a patent in her name from 1924, but it also includes a sketch of a similar valve by another engineer in 1918.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: So the patent doesn’t settle who had the idea first.

sentences.speaker: Isaac
sentences.text: Right. The local engineering journal calls her a pioneer in bringing the design into everyday use, and gives examples from several buildings.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Let’s describe that work and its source, but remove the claim that she invented the first valve of its kind.

sentences.speaker: Isaac
sentences.text: Agreed. I’ll keep the patent date as a separate fact, not proof of priority.
